name: Commencement Reception
description: Planarcadia presents a special welcome gift for the Trailblazer: an invitation for a former companion to join your trailblazing expedition. Come, let us share a laugh together under the glow of the Phantasmoon.
introduction:
◆ Event Details ◆
● During the event, Trailblazers can log in to select one of the following 5-star characters:
Jing Yuan, Kafka, Dan Heng • Imbibitor Lunae, Jingliu, Sparkle, Acheron, or Aventurine.
● Upon claiming a character, you will receive corresponding supplies to immediately raise them to Lv. 60.
● If the selected character's Eidolons are already maxed out, the reward will be converted into Silver Companion Spirit.
